# Pull Request Template

## Summary

Explain the change briefly.

## Related Issues

Closes issue number reference (e.g. #123)

## Changes

- [ ] Code
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] CI

## Checklist

- [ ] Added/updated tests
- [ ] Ran `pytest` locally (all green)
- [ ] Ran `ruff check` and `mypy` (no new errors)
- [ ] Updated README / docs if needed
- [ ] Added entry to CHANGELOG (if existing)

## Notes for Reviewer

Optional notes or concerns.
